faqs.question: What do you need from me to start a WordPress project?
faqs.answer: To get started, share your project goals, required pages or features, preferred design direction, existing website URL if applicable, and any content or references you already have.

faqs.question: Will my website work properly on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Responsive behavior is considered across desktop, tablet and mobile so the website can adapt properly to different screen sizes.

faqs.question: Do you build WooCommerce websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. I work on WooCommerce stores including products, cart, checkout and project-specific e-commerce requirements.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing WordPress website?
faqs.answer: Yes. Existing WordPress websites can be redesigned while keeping the project requirements, content and required functionality in focus.

faqs.question: Can you fix WordPress malware and security issues?
faqs.answer: Yes. I provide WordPress malware cleanup, including removal of malware, injected malicious code and backdoors.

faqs.question: Do you provide website speed optimization?
faqs.answer: Yes. I work on WordPress performance optimization and use practical caching and performance tools such as WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache and W3 Total Cache where appropriate.

faqs.question: Do you provide SEO with the website?
faqs.answer: SEO support can include on-page SEO, local SEO, SEO audits and WordPress SEO setup depending on the project scope.

faqs.question: Can I update the website myself after completion?
faqs.answer: WordPress websites can be set up so common content can be managed through the dashboard. The exact editing experience depends on the website structure and tools used.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing WordPress maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing maintenance and support can cover updates, fixes, website changes and other agreed WordPress support requirements.

faqs.question: Can you handle custom WordPress requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Depending on the requirement, I can work with custom CSS, JavaScript, PHP, theme files, plugins and WordPress workflows.

faqs.question: How much does a WordPress website cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the project scope, pages, functionality and custom requirements. You can share your requirements to get a project quote.

faqs.question: How long will my website take to complete?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the project size, required functionality, content readiness and revision requirements. A timeline can be discussed after reviewing the project scope.
